content: Prop Firm Landscape 2026: Compared 6 active firms (FTMO, FundedNext, Topstep, The5ers, Apex, E8 Markets) and documented 4 recent shutdowns (MyFundedFX Feb 2026, FundingTicks Jan 2026, True Forex Funds 2023, MyForexFunds 2023). Key findings: (1) FTMO remains gold standard but counterparty risk is real — diversification needed. (2) FundedNext is strongest alternative: 8% P1 target, $261M+ paid, weekend holds allowed, 15% eval profit payout on failure. (3) Critical hidden rules for EA trading: trailing drawdown moves with peak equity, Best Day Rule 40-50% cap, server request limit 2000/day, news blackout 2min on funded accounts, VPN=termination, cross-firm hedging detected via shared data, inactivity 30d=closure. (4) Multi-firm strategy: Phase 1 single FTMO mastery → Phase 2 add FundedNext → Phase 3 scale to 3-5 accounts. (5) FTMO pass rates: P1 8-15%, both phases 4-10%, ever receive payout 1-2%. (6) CFTC may classify prop firms as CTAs. (7) MetaQuotes ended white-label licensing, cTrader dominant alternative. (8) P0 code changes needed: news blackout enforcement, Best Day Rule tracking, server request rate limiter.

actionable_items.change: News blackout window (2min hard block around NFP/CPI/FOMC)
Consistency smoothing (lot reduction after outsized wins)
